Dense cell x IZ x position replication tensor

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
build_replication_tensor.Rd

1 where a cell's merged track covers position center + rel_bp of the IZ (rel_bp from -window_bp to window_bp by bin_size), else 0.

Usage

build_replication_tensor(
  track_intervals,
  cell_ids,
  iz_metadata,
  iz_ids,
  window_bp = 500000L,
  bin_size = 20000L,
  max_elements = 5e+07
)

Arguments

track_intervals

prepare_iz_data()$track_intervals.

cell_ids

Cells (first dimension).

iz_metadata

prepare_iz_data()$iz_metadata.

iz_ids

IZs (second dimension).

window_bp, bin_size

Window half-width and step (bp).

max_elements

Maximum number of tensor elements.

Value

A numeric array, cells x IZs x positions.
